name: Helmfile
description: Installs helmfile together with Helm and the helm-diff plugin required by helmfile.

install.description: Install helmfile, Helm, and the helm-diff plugin.

version.description: helmfile version to install (e.g., 1.8.2). Use 'latest' for the most recent release.

helmVersion.description: Helm version to install (e.g., 4.3.1). Use 'latest' for the most recent release.

helmDiffVersion.description: helm-diff plugin version to install (e.g., 3.15.15). Use 'latest' for the most recent release.
